why: First pass: an IMF target for end-2025 read as use
First pass: payment of non-tax revenue fees, not taxes
First pass: a finance law's provision read as practice

Top-stage check, stage 4c 2026-10-18: PwC says registered taxpayers generate a reference on the platform and then instruct their commercial bank to pay; non-registered pay and submit proof at the tax office. Online filing is stated, payment through the authority's system is not (bank payment may be over the counter).
Stage 4c 2026-10-27: CIAT says SIGT aims to dematerialise filing and payment and lists a Taxpayer Portal; it does not say taxpayers file returns online.
Stage 4c 2026-10-27: SIGT aims to cover payment and a Settlement Note/Payment Receipt tool is listed; payment through the authority's system is not stated (as MOZ-003).

Stage 4c 2026-10-30: decree 2.25.862 requires non-resident suppliers of digital services to file VAT returns electronically, in force six months after publication, and the DGI platform for it opened in May 2026 (MAR-006). That is online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, not a system under way.
